parsed_json.up: Select compounds tested against human TRPV1 (CHEMBL4794) with IC50 values in nM that have a SMILES string and are reported in a publication with a PubMed ID or DOI. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Use an INNER JOIN to compound_structures to enforce the presence of canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL4794, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and require pubmed_id or doi to be non-null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
